_meta.notes: Every Summary Page cell (Lines 1-7, both columns) is written as a hand-drawn slashed zero; recorded as 0 throughout. The District Number '1' is written in the box to the right of 'District Number'.

contributions.detail: Schedule A carries no contribution lines; the filer drew a slashed zero in each of the five columns of the FIRST data row and in both the SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells. Per the zero-glyph ruling a slashed circle IS zero, so the page total is 0, matching Summary Page line 1 Column A (0). A real zero.

expenditures.detail: Schedule B carries no expenditure lines; a large freehand 'N/A' is written diagonally across the middle of the table and the SUBTOTAL / TOTAL cells were left EMPTY. Per the zero-glyph ruling 'N/A' is NOT a numeral, so no figure is read from the page - but the schedule is genuinely empty and Summary Page line 2 Column A is 0. A real zero.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 rows sum 0 = printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE (slashed zero) = printed TOTAL (slashed zero) - gate fired and passed; p4 has NO gate (both the SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells are empty; the page carries only an 'N/A' mark)
itemized.notes: BLANK SCHEDULES, both sides, marked two different ways by the same filer. Schedule A header box 'Page 2 of 2 / De Cair / 9-14-06'; Schedule B's header box was left blank. NO itemized row is emitted for the row of slashed zeros on Schedule A - it is a 'nothing to report' mark written across the columns, not a contribution line; treating it as a row would fabricate a donor.
